Keyframes.description: Animation keyframes keyed by object id. Each value is an ordered array of keyframes for that object.

items.description: A single animation keyframe. Timing fields (delay/duration/endDelay) advance the object's timeline; any of the animatable attributes sets a target value the object tweens to over `duration` ms. Blank fields are ignored — omit any attribute you don't want to animate.

delay.description: Milliseconds to wait after the previous frame ends before this frame's tween starts. Capped at 10000.

duration.description: Milliseconds the tween runs for. Must be > 0 for the frame to occupy time. Capped at 10000.

endDelay.description: Milliseconds to hold the frame's final state before the next frame's delay starts. Capped at 10000.

easing.description: anime.js easing function applied to this frame's tween. Defaults to easeInOutQuad.

rotateX.description: 3D rotation around the X axis in degrees

rotateY.description: 3D rotation around the Y axis in degrees

rotateZ.description: 3D rotation around the Z axis in degrees

perspective.description: Perspective distance in pixels applied to the object's container. Required for rotateX/Y/Z to render as true 3D — without it, rotations appear flat.

text-effect.description: Text layers only — cascades the named preset across each word in the text container. Ignored on non-text objects.

text-effect-speed.description: Per-word stagger in ms. `auto` divides the frame's duration evenly across words.

text-effect-easing.description: Easing applied to each word's cascade. Falls back to the frame's `easing` if omitted.

anchor-gap-y.description: Vertical offset from the anchor point in pixels

adaptive-position.description: How the layer repositions when the template is resized

adaptive-size.description: How the layer resizes when the template is resized

adaptive-aspect-ratio.description: Whether the layer keeps its aspect ratio when adaptively resized

adaptive-anchor-gap.description: How the anchor gap adjusts when the template is resized

color.description: Text or fill color as hex, rgb, or named color

text-highlight-color.description: Background color behind individual lines of text

text-highlight-padding-vertical.description: Vertical padding around text highlight in pixels

text-highlight-padding-horizontal.description: Horizontal padding around text highlight in pixels

text-background-image-mask.description: Image URL to use as a clipping mask for the text fill

line-height.description: Line height multiplier for text spacing

text-decoration.description: Text decoration: none, underline, or overline

text-transform.description: Text capitalization: none, uppercase, lowercase, or capitalize

align-items.description: Vertical text alignment within the container

word-break.description: Word breaking behavior for long words

white-space.description: How whitespace and line breaks are handled

text-shadow.description: Text shadow in CSS format e.g. 2px 2px 4px #000

text-stroke-width.description: Width of the text outline stroke in pixels

text-stroke-color.description: Color of the text outline stroke

font-family-secondary.description: Font family for text wrapped in *asterisks*

color-secondary.description: Text color for text wrapped in *asterisks*

font-weight-secondary.description: Font weight for text wrapped in *asterisks*

font-style-secondary.description: Font style for text wrapped in *asterisks*

text-transform-secondary.description: Text transform for text wrapped in *asterisks*

text-decoration-secondary.description: Text decoration for text wrapped in *asterisks*

text-fit.description: How text is sized to fit its container

text-ellipsis.description: Truncate overflowing text with an ellipsis

background-image.description: Image URL to display in the container

background-color-gradient.description: Second color for a two-color gradient fill

background-size.description: How the background image fills the container

background-position.description: Anchor position for the background image within the container — most useful when background-size is contain

background-blend-mode.description: Blend mode applied to the background image

ai-detect.description: AI detection mode for automatic image positioning

ai-detect-focus.description: Which detection to focus on when multiple are found

ai-detect-on-fail.description: Fallback background-size when no face or subject is detected

ai-detect-zoom.description: Zoom level for AI detection crop

ai-detect-anchor.description: Manual anchor point override for AI detection in x:y format (0-100)

ai-background-remove.description: Whether to automatically remove the background of images submitted to this container via the API

ai-background-generate.description: Whether the container should generate its background image via AI when an ai-prompt is supplied in the API request

ai-prompt.description: Prompt for AI background generation — applies when the layer has ai-background-generate enabled

png-stroke-width.description: Outline stroke width around PNG images in pixels

png-stroke-color.description: Outline stroke color around PNG images

png-shadow.description: Drop shadow for PNG images in CSS shadow format

stroke.description: Stroke color of the shape outline

stroke-width.description: Stroke width of the shape outline in pixels

qr-target.description: URL or text content to encode in the QR code

qr-color.description: Foreground color of the QR code

barcode-data.description: Data to encode in the barcode

rating-shape.description: Shape used for each rating unit

rating-color.description: Fill color for active rating shapes

rating-background-color.description: Fill color for inactive rating shapes

rating-gap.description: Gap between rating shapes in pixels

rating-stroke-color.description: Outline stroke color for rating shapes

rating-stroke-width.description: Outline stroke width for rating shapes in pixels

rating-shadow.description: Drop shadow for rating shapes in CSS shadow format

font-family.description: Font family name (Google Fonts or custom font)

border-radius.description: Border radius in pixels for rounded corners

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata string stored with the video
